events.title: Flash Flood near South Peacham
events.description: 1 death. Caledonia County. Public video/picture of severe flash flooding along the Stevens River in Barnet Village. Subsequent reports from Emergency Mgmt. and NWS Storm Surveys the following morning confirmed severe to devastating flash flooding throughout the Barnet and Peacham area with numerous roads and structures heavily damaged or destroyed.

events.title: Flash Flood near Ricker Mills
events.description: 1 death. Caledonia County. CoCoRaHS observer reported flash flooding along Depot Brook in Groton. NWS Storm surveys the following morning confirmed additional, and in some cases severe flash flooding in Groton, particularly along stretches of US Route 302. Here, several tributaries to the adjacent Wells River damaged the road, driveways and some structures.

events.title: Flash Flood near North Danville
events.description: 1 death. Caledonia County. Official NWS storm surveys confirmed severe to locally devastating damage from flash flooding in the St. Johnsbury Center and Lyndon areas. Numerous roads and bridges were damaged with several homes and businesses experiencing severe damage, especially on Center St. in Lyndonville where a fatality occurred. Valid time listed from initial call from public concerning flash flooding on Red Village Road in Lyndonville.

events.title: Flash Flood near Montpelier Jct
events.description: 1 death. Washington County. Three to seven inches of rain fell during the afternoon/evening of July 10 and into the morning hours on July 11. Severe flash flooding occurred, most notably in the Barre area where the Stevens and Jail Branches of the Winooski River were overwhelmed. A number of homes and businesses were damaged, especially along Route 302. A few landslides also occurred, causing damage.

events.title: Flash Flood near Chester
events.description: 1 death. Windsor County. Training showers and thunderstorms with heavy rainfall affected this area between the early morning and early to mid afternoon on July 10. Observations and radar estimates show 3 to 7 inches of rainfall occurred, with localized totals to 8 inches. Severe to devastating flash flooding occurred in several towns during this period, most notably in Weston, Ludlow, Plymouth and Bridgewater.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Champlain Arpt
events.description: 2 deaths. Chittenden County. Numerous branches and a few trees down on several roads in Colchester Mallets Bay area, including Prim, Porters Point, Colchester Point. Eldery couple were kayaking near Thayers beach when the storm struck and both capsized and drowned.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Hubbardton
events.description: 1 death. Rutland County. Trees down along Route 30 and other parts of town, some falling on structures. 1 fatality.
